name: open-download-manager
description: Wave 1 workspace command orchestrator for Open Download Manager

scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.base.json --pretty false && corepack pnpm --filter @odm/desktop --fail-if-no-match run typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @odm/browser-extension --fail-if-no-match run typecheck
scripts.test:policy: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts apps/browser-extension/tests && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts tests/scaffold/policy
scripts.test: corepack pnpm test:unit && corepack pnpm test:policy && corepack pnpm test:topology && corepack pnpm test:extension-build
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @odm/desktop --fail-if-no-match run build && corepack pnpm --filter @odm/browser-extension --fail-if-no-match run build
scripts.check: corepack pnpm format:check && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm test:e2e && corepack pnpm build && corepack pnpm rust:fmt && corepack pnpm rust:clippy && corepack pnpm rust:test && corepack pnpm rust:build && corepack pnpm tauri:build
